class.name: KilnGIProxy
class.brief_description: Imported simplified geometry and solid-color materials for Kiln diffuse GI.
class.description: OBJ and scene importers automatically store this resource in a mesh's [code]kiln_gi_proxy[/code] metadata. The proxy preserves material and open geometric boundaries. Source albedo, emission, textures and vertex color settings automatically refresh its solid-color materials, including after loading a saved resource. Runtime instance overrides are evaluated separately by [KilnGIWorld], so shared geometry can use different material responses. Rigid opaque meshes are supported; skinned geometry, blend shapes, alpha-cutout silhouettes and arbitrary shader deformation are not supported. This API is specific to the Kiln fork.

method.name: get_material_revision
method.description: Returns the number of material refreshes since this resource was created or loaded. Material refreshes reuse simplified geometry.

members.member: Internal serialized source fingerprints, surface mapping and simplification settings. Managed by the importer.
